title: microcoder repository tests (local_run, follow_up) fail on Linux (Boat)
body: Reported by the #10279 agent: two or three `microcoder` `repository::tests` (`local_run`, `follow_up`) fail on Boat Linux at clean origin/main, after #10285 (47dd087f72) fixed the macOS local_run failure. Reproduce on Linux, find the platform/environment cause (installed engines, PATH, sandbox, OpenCode/Devin config), fix without weakening checks; suite clean on Linux and macOS.
